g.text: Wednesday 22 July, 09:30. One call to the statement tool returns Corvane's whole quarter. The agent
Okafor follows the trace turn by turn. The quarter is there on turn two, where it was asked for. It is
there again on turn three, and on turn nine.
"It is carrying Corvane everywhere it goes," he says.
By the ninth request most of what LANTERN is reading is statements it has finished with. Case file 02
chapter 20 counted the cost in tokens. Nobody has yet asked what it costs in room.
"Can it put them down?" Varma asks.
